text:
carla: Uploaded a relnotes draft for routing + batching: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/701. Need snippet sanity, deprecation note for legacy cache, and short known-issues blurb before publish.

ev an: quick scan shows a reference to `redis-prefix-cache` in the depgraph section. that was removed in v0.9 — we should add a deprecation banner and link to the migration guide.

mina: snippets check: python and js examples use `model: 'kestrel'` which will 404. change to `kestrel-v2`. i'll open a tiny PR for that.

sunil: add one-line fallback note in the routing table for CS: "During autoscale warm-up requests may be routed to compatible smaller variants; pin model_variant to avoid this." keep it short.

docs-ci: PR #701 updated by carla — files changed: docs/relnotes/2024-08-routing-batching.md, snippets/js/kestrel_example.md. linkcheck queued.

ev an: ran linkcheck: 3 broken anchors, 1 external redirect. i'll push anchor fixes and suggested redirects so we don't break existing links.

mina: PR #702 opened to swap snippets to `kestrel-v2` and standardize param name to `model=`. includes snippet render test.

sunil: suggested known-issue wording (pasteable):
Known issue: autoscale routing fallback
- Symptom: brief routing to fallback variants during cold starts under high concurrency
- Mitigation: pin model_variant on Dedicated routes or increase warm-pool size
- Tracking: INF-3124

carla: added that verbatim plus a deprecation row for `redis-prefix-cache` with a short migration link. will wait for anchor PR before final publish.

docs-ci: PR #703 (anchor fixes) merged by evan — linkcheck clean on staging.

carla: final checklist:
- [x] Deprecation callout added
- [x] Snippets updated (PY/JS)
- [x] Known-issue blurb added (INF-3124)
- [x] Linkcheck green on staging
- [ ] JP localization: mina to open i18n stub

mina: i'll add /i18n/jp/relnotes/2024-08-routing.md stub in ~2h. if it misses the window we ship EN and follow up with JP patch.

carla: thanks — scheduling publish window for 18:00 UTC. will post announcement copy here for review before sending. :rocket:
